primary_cluster: family_id:20 independent layout families, retains both roots and branches and overlapping windows
sensitivity_cluster: root_id:40 common physical roots, retains both branches and all windows; correlations across roots of same family remain, so primaryfamily is conservative choice
paired_resampling: Same selected clusters for observed rate, nonlinear reference, model conditions; no independent-window binomialCI, seeds separately fixed weights not doubleddata
main_difference: D_equal = observed free three-boundary all-correct fraction minus matched first-step success fraction cubed
secondary_differences: D_marginal = same joint minus product of actual three marginal success fractions; D_unmatched = joint minus all480one-step fraction cubed, shown to explain original4.4pp only
interval: Percentile95% group pairedbootstrap, estimates data-layout sampling variability conditional on fitted models; not training-seed variance
acceptance: No practical tolerance or planning risk threshold specified. CI including0 does not establish equivalence or acceptance. Cube-root per-step equivalent is descriptive only.
